name: benchcompass-benchmark-eval
description: Ollama yerel model degerlendirme aracı: hiz (tok/s, prefill, TTFT) + kalite (24+ EN / TR gorev suite). MD + interaktif HTML rapor uretir.

runtime.requirements: sadece stdlib (urllib, json, argparse) — ucuncu parti bagimlilik YOK

architecture.note: Plugin kendi icinde tam bagimsiz calisir. Baska bir projeye plugin/benchcompass-benchmark-eval/ klasorunu kopyala -> cd -> python -m benchcompass_benchmark_eval.scripts.run_benchmark --pipeline

resolution_order: 3. yoksa llmfit verisi olmadan calis (graceful degradation)
llmfit_integration.shared_data_folder: parent projenin data/ (hf_models.json, benchmark_cache.json) entegre modda okunur

integration_points.detail: pipeline sonuclari source='plugin-eval' ile INSERT edilir

html_features.charts: hybrid: Chart.js CDN denenir, yoksa elle SVG/Canvas fallback
